methodologyNotes: Dataset covers 12 handheld digital multimeters (DMMs) across professional, DIY, HVAC, and automotive segments. Specs re-verified against manufacturer product pages (Fluke, Klein Tools, AstroAI, Extech, Fieldpiece, Innova, Amprobe), the official Fluke 114/115/116/117 detailed-specifications PDF, and corroborating distributor/retail listings (ToolNut, Test Equipment Depot, trutechtools.com, AutoZone). Prices reflect published US MSRP or, where the manufacturer publishes no USD MSRP (regionally priced/budget models), a corroborated current US retail price; where no published USD price could be confirmed, priceUsd is null. Booleans indicate presence (true)/absence (false) of a feature as documented by the manufacturer; count_resolution is the maximum display count as an integer; low_impedance_loz refers to the dedicated voltage-measurement LoZ mode for eliminating ghost/stray voltages. Adversarial corrections this pass: Fluke 117 temperature removed (the 116, not the 117, has the K-type thermocouple per Fluke detailed specs); Fluke 101 corrected to non-True-RMS (average-responding per teardown) with price nulled (no published USD MSRP); Innova 3340 price corrected to AutoZone street price. accessedAt 2026-06-20.

products.name: Fluke 117
products.provenance: Fluke.com confirms MSRP $304.99, True RMS, 6000-count display, CAT III 600 V, AutoVolt auto-ranging, and selectable low-impedance (LoZ) mode. CORRECTED temperature_measurement true->false: the official Fluke 114/115/116/117 detailed-specifications PDF lists the K-type thermocouple temperature function for the 116 ONLY; the 117 does not measure temperature (multiple sources confirm the 116 is the HVAC temp model, the 117 is the electrician's model).

products.name: Fluke 87V

specs.cat_safety_rating: CAT IV 600 V / CAT III 1000 V

products.provenance: Fluke.com confirms MSRP $561.99, True RMS, 6000-count display (19,999 in high-resolution mode), CAT IV 600 V / CAT III 1000 V, auto and manual ranging, and built-in thermometer (-200 C to +1090 C with probe). No dedicated voltage-mode LoZ feature documented; all fields re-verified against fluke.com.

products.name: Fluke 115
products.provenance: Fluke.com confirms MSRP $279.99, True RMS, 6000-count, CAT III 600 V, auto-ranging. Fluke 114/115/116/117 detailed-specifications PDF confirms the 115 has NO temperature function (116 only) and NO Auto-V LoZ mode (114/116/117 only). temperature_measurement false and low_impedance_loz false both verified correct.

products.name: Klein Tools MM600
products.priceNote: Street price (discontinued; Klein now recommends MM720)

specs.cat_safety_rating: CAT IV 600 V / CAT III 1000 V

products.provenance: Klein Tools product page confirms non-TRMS (the TRMS replacement is the MM720), 4000-count LCD, 1000 V DC, CAT IV 600 V / CAT III 1000 V, auto-ranging, and temperature 0-1000 F. Page states 'no longer in production' and recommends MM720. Street price ~$86.49 per current retail listings.

products.name: Klein Tools MM700

specs.cat_safety_rating: CAT IV 600 V / CAT III 1000 V

products.provenance: Klein Tools product page confirms TRMS, LoZ mode, auto-ranging, 1000 V DC, temperature, 4000-count LCD, and CAT IV 600 V / CAT III 1000 V. ToolNut lists at $99.97 and confirms all features. Discontinued (newer model MM720) but still widely sold.

products.name: Klein Tools MM400
products.provenance: Klein Tools product page (now showing 'no longer in production', recommends MM420) confirms non-TRMS, 4000-count LCD, 600 V DC, CAT III 600 V, auto-ranging, and temperature measurement. Street price ~$54.97 from distributors.

products.name: AstroAI DM6000AR
products.priceNote: Price from astroai.com US product page

specs.cat_safety_rating: CAT III 600 V / CAT II 1000 V

products.provenance: AstroAI US product page shows $39.99 and confirms True RMS, 6000 counts, DC range to 1000 V, auto and manual ranging, and K-type temperature. Manual confirms EN61010-1 CAT III 600 V / CAT II 1000 V. No LoZ ghost-voltage mode.

products.name: Innova 3340
products.priceNote: Current price at AutoZone (manufacturer MSRP on innova.com is $129)
products.provenance: Innova.com confirms 600 V max, auto-ranging, and temperature via K-type probe; not True RMS (no TRMS claim in manual or product page). CORRECTED priceUsd 79.99->69.99: AutoZone (the named retail source) currently lists $69.99; innova.com MSRP is $129. The draft's $79.99 matched neither. 4000-count (3-3/4 digit) and CAT II per the IEC measuring-circuit category in the manual.

products.name: Fieldpiece HS33
products.provenance: Trutechtools.com confirms MSRP $245.00 (sale ~$208), manual ranging (not auto), 3.5-digit LCD with maximum reading 1999 (2000-count class), CAT III 600 V, and temperature via K-type thermocouple. Average AC conversion, not True RMS (the TRMS stick is the HS36). No LoZ mode.

products.name: Amprobe AM-510
products.priceNote: Current price at Test Equipment Depot
products.provenance: Amprobe page confirms 4000-count LCD, 600 V, CAT III 600 V, auto and manual ranging, temperature (-40 F to 1832 F), and NCV. Average-responding, not True RMS (TRMS starts at AM-530). Test Equipment Depot lists $47.95; amprobe.com publishes no USD price.

products.name: Extech EX330
products.priceNote: Price from extech.com / Test Equipment Depot

specs.cat_safety_rating: CAT II 1000 V / CAT III 600 V

products.provenance: Extech.com confirms $74.99, 4000-count LCD, 600 V max, CAT II 1000 V / CAT III 600 V, autoranging, Type K temperature probe, and NCV. Not True RMS (the EX430 adds TRMS). No LoZ mode.

products.name: Fluke 101
products.priceNote: Fluke publishes no USD MSRP for this model (a non-US-market budget pocket meter); US street prices vary widely (~$48-90) with no single corroborable published price, so priceUsd is null
products.provenance: Fluke.com confirms CAT III 600 V and 600 V max; 6000-count display confirmed by reviews. CORRECTED true_rms true->false: Mark Hennessy's detailed teardown and multiple reviews confirm the Fluke 101 is AVERAGE-RESPONDING, not True RMS. Temperature absent (not in function list). CORRECTED source URL from fluke.com/en-us (model not listed in the US store) to fluke.com/en-in (the regional page that actually exists). CORRECTED priceUsd 48.5->null: no published USD MSRP and the draft's $48.50 (stale CamelCamelCamel Nov 2024 figure) could not be corroborated to a current published listing.
